Figure 2:Overview ofPoS.Belief Modeling constructs and incrementally updates a task-conditioned Belief from interaction evidence (Section3.1).
Belief-Guided Interaction conditions each action on the current Belief and an Active Gap, while the Belief Sentinel validates consistency and records task-relevant progress (Section3.2).
Trapping-Aware Recovery estimates Belief health, diagnoses heterogeneous trapping conditions, and composes recovery constraints to restore progress (Section3.3).
